source: ACT Government (TCCS / City Services), ACT Tree Register, ACTGOV Tree Register public view
licence_proof: ArcGIS item 3886f145a44f43e6a1a4b061b532d4c2 (www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/...?f=json) licenseInfo reads verbatim: "Creative Commons By Attribution 4.0 (Australian Capital Territory)" and "Please read Data Terms and Conditions statement before data use (https://www.actmapi.act.gov.au/terms.html)". Not read: that terms page. data.gov.au lists the licence as "Other", so the item field is the only proof.
designation: Registered and provisionally registered trees under the Urban Forest Act 2023, decided by the Conservator of Flora and Fauna for exceptional natural or cultural heritage, landscape or scientific value
scope: All 376 polygon rows: 350 REGISTERED, 17 PROVISIONAL, 9 CANCELLED (cancelled rows must never ship). Built-up urban area of Canberra only. 244 SINGLE, 114 GROUP, 12 MULTIPLE SINGLES. 323 rows carry a trunk circumference.
caveat: Geometry is a polygon (crown or group footprint); latitude/longitude here are the vertex mean, so approximate, never confirmed. Many LOCATION values are generic (URBAN OPEN SPACE, ROAD VERGE, SUBURBAN); some rows are private residential addresses (RZ_RESIDENTIAL) and must not ship as visitable. GROUP rows are an avenue or stand, not one collectible point. TRUNK_CIRCUMFERENCE_CM units not yet sanity-checked against species beyond the top rows (1030 cm red box looks plausible for a large eucalypt; check before use). Many trees are native eucalypts of the pre-city woodland, few have an age. No vitality field.
